what: Check a palette against WCAG contrast thresholds — a11y_check_palette
title: Check a palette against WCAG contrast thresholds — a11y_check_palette
text: Computes contrast ratio every color reference background reports whether meets WCAG threshold (4.5:1 AA, 7:1 AAA). alpha < 1, contrast computed alpha-composited rendered color – color viewer actually sees. Works palette – viridis, RColorBrewer, plotly's discrete sequences, custom hex vector.

title: Check a palette against WCAG contrast thresholds — a11y_check_palette
Check a palette against WCAG contrast thresholds — a11y_check_palette
text: colors Character vector hex codes. bg Reference background hex(es). Pass single value (e.g. "#ffffff") vector (e.g. c("#ffffff", "#1a1a1a")) verify multiple backgrounds. Returns one row per (color, bg) pair. level "AA" (4.5:1) "AAA" (7:1). Use "AA-large" (3:1) non-text elements data marks, axis lines, focus rings. alpha Opacity [0, 1]. 1 (default) checks raw color. Values 1 composite color bg first, check rendered result – useful chart geoms use alpha < 1.

title: a11yviz 0.1.0
